searchText: <glamperd> My test site is here: https://trustedsetuptest.web.app/ <glamperd> The requirement for nonce>=3 is commented out in this version. Use any old ETH account. <glamperd> The computation will use multiple web workers. Looks like it fails in some browsers (e.g. Mozilla) It works in Chrome. could we add more crypto-native options for "participate using"? Like say, sign in with ethereum if you have >=1 ETH or a PoH or a POAP (if we need some kind of anti-sybil) <CarlBeek> yeah, this is very much the plan! currently we're focusing on getting the crypto side of things up, running, and stable. <timbeiko> Yeah, and I'd even say that for the "real" ceremony, ETH-native login should be the default, and GH should act as a backup only. Probably want >1 backup too, with Twitter a likely easy integration? Not sure if there's a China/Russia auth-able app we should also link? <vbuterin> Github is the one that's easily accessible everywhere
